question: The average of 13 numbers is 92. If the first 7 numbers are 30, 32, 46, 81, 110, 73 and 20, then what will be the average of the remaining numbers?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total sum = 13 × 92 = 1196

Sum of first 7 = 392

Remaining sum = 1196 − 392 = 804

Average = 804 ÷ 6 = 134

**∴ Answer = 134**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total numbers = 13

Average = 92

First 7 numbers = 30, 32, 46, 81, 110, 73, 20

**Formula used:**

Average = Total sum ÷ Number of terms

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total sum of 13 numbers = 13 × 92 = 1196

⇒ Sum of first 7 numbers = 30 + 32 + 46 + 81 + 110 + 73 + 20 = 392

⇒ Sum of remaining numbers = 1196 − 392 = 804

⇒ Remaining numbers = 6

⇒ Average = 804 ÷ 6

⇒ = 134

**∴ The correct answer is 134.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Formula

Average = Total sum ÷ Number of values

Reverse Method

Total sum = Average × Number of values

Partition Concept

Total sum = sum of known + unknown parts
